title: Rileylink/Omnipod Error 049
symptom: AAPS lost connection to the Rileylink/Omnipod because of out-of-reachment, and then an Error 049 occurred. The error occurred multiple times, including about 2 hours after setting a new pod.
evidence_quote: Aps lost connection to the Rileylink/Omnipod because of out-of-reachment.
